claim_boundary.admitted_if_pass: checkpoint- and trace-bound FC1 weighted destination-group task-compaction opportunity and deterministic INT8 accumulator bound
not_admitted: task router, bank-conflict-free schedule, RTL, VCS, DC, physical SRAM, power, energy, modified-forward accuracy, full FFN speedup, system speedup, or headline
the two stage3 nonbinary FC1 modules

decision.promote_to_accuracy_screen: only group-size 4/8 points crossing the 1.15 optimistic sensitivity gate; a miss remains a hard NO-GO

mechanism.deterministic_bound: each omitted task changes each destination INT8 accumulator by at most beta; a runtime omitted-source counter gives beta times count
mechanism.name: bounded destination-group source-task elision
mechanism.required_hardware_not_modeled: group-task metadata, compactor, tag router, conflict-free accumulator service, and their cycles/area
mechanism.skip_predicate: omit a source/destination-group task only when every per-row INT8 weight in that group has absolute value <= beta
mechanism.zero_budget_behavior: beta=0 performs no pruning and is the exact engine subset
